description: Retention (quest_lw_4): the moment Sub-Registrar Nine steps out from behind the desk, Halcyon stops treating this as an HR matter and opens a recovery. Spawns two Adjusters into the Vat Hall next door, each stamped with the player's own id as suspect_id — that flag is what their CHASE node reads in quarry:flag mode, so they hunt THIS player specifically rather than aggroing on whoever wanders past. They arrive silently and unleashed (leash_radius -1); the player finds out they exist by being followed. Note there's deliberately no hunter flag: hunter is the enforcement exemption from the sanctuary rule, and an Adjuster carrying it would walk into the Long Watch bunker at the end of the escort.

notice.text: Somewhere above you a terminal chimes once, politely, the way a terminal does when a file has been marked for recovery rather than review.

name: Retention — Halcyon opens a recovery
